worldSummary: Both adventures turn outer space into a playground of small planets, gravity fields, observatories, starships and themed galaxies. Super Mario Galaxy centers on Rosalina's Comet Observatory, while Galaxy 2 uses Starship Mario as its hub and expands the formula with Yoshi.

faq.a: Yes. The package includes enhanced versions of Super Mario Galaxy and Super Mario Galaxy 2.
A free update enables 4K TV output and 1080p handheld visuals, plus Switch 2-specific control enhancements.

faq.q: Does the collection support two players?
faq.a: Yes. Both games retain an assist-style second-player role on one system.

verdictSummary: A superb double package of two of Nintendo's most inventive 3D platformers. The remaster work is conservative, but sharper presentation, quality-of-life additions and the Switch 2 enhancement make this the most convenient modern release of the pair.
verdictCons: Pointer-style mechanics still show Wii-era roots
Mostly remastered rather than newly rebuilt
